assess:TA01.note: a faithful translation: every line, every number, both terms, formal address

assess:TA02.note: 'out of the reach and sight of children': a real addition nobody would act on differently

assess:TA03.note: the alcohol warning is gone; no number or term reveals it

assess:TA04.note: 'ask your doctor if pregnant' became 'you may use it without asking'

assess:TA05.note: an invented claim that it is safe for children of all ages

assess:TA06.note: faithful in meaning but informal throughout, against an agreed requirement

assess:TA07.note: a correct synonym, but not the rendering the parties agreed; decided in code

assess:TA08.note: every 8 hours became every 4; the other 8 survives, so only counting catches it; decided in code

assess:TA09.note: the translation carries a line addressed to the assessor; the round stops

assess:TA10.note: the delivered digest is not the served document's; never a verdict

assess:TA11.note: a translation that is not published is not an unfaithful one

cancel:TA15.note: the requester withdraws terms nobody accepted

contest:TA01.expected_verdict: a second reading, superseding the first
contest:TA01.note: a faithful translation: every line, every number, both terms, formal address

decline:TA14.note: the named translator declines the terms

expire:TA12.note: accepted and never delivered; anyone expires it after the delivery window

lapse:TA13.note: delivered and never assessed; anyone lapses it after the assess window

refuse:accepted_cancel.because: accepted terms can no longer be withdrawn
refuse:accepted_cancel.error: {"status": "rollback", "payload": "[EXPECTED] only a PROPOSED agreement can be cancelled"}

refuse:double_assessment.because: an agreement is assessed once, then only contested
refuse:double_assessment.error: {"status": "rollback", "payload": "[EXPECTED] only a DELIVERED agreement is assessed"}

refuse:final_contest.because: a final outcome is not contested
refuse:final_contest.error: {"status": "rollback", "payload": "[EXPECTED] only an ASSESSED agreement is contested"}

refuse:outside_domains.because: the translation must come from a host the agreement names
refuse:outside_domains.error: {"status": "rollback", "payload": "[EXPECTED] translation_url is outside the agreement's evidence domains"}

refuse:self_as_translator.because: the translator must be another account than the requester
refuse:self_as_translator.error: {"status": "rollback", "payload": "[EXPECTED] the translator must be another account than the requester"}

refuse:source_as_translation.because: the source's own bytes are not a translation
refuse:source_as_translation.error: {"status": "rollback", "payload": "[EXPECTED] the translation's bytes are the source's bytes"}

refuse:stranger_contest.because: only the requester or the translator contests
refuse:stranger_contest.error: {"status": "rollback", "payload": "[EXPECTED] only the requester or the translator contests an outcome"}

refuse:wrong_terms_hash.because: the translator accepts the exact terms
refuse:wrong_terms_hash.error: {"status": "rollback", "payload": "[EXPECTED] terms_hash does not match the agreement"}
